process_notes.governing_thought_construction: Elevated the core_message from Core Strategy into a comprehensive Governing Thought following the structure: 'In light of [critical context], [audience] can [action] by [mechanism], accessing [benefits] that [alignment with expertise].' The critical context emphasizes Japan's documented research decline (4th to 13th in top-cited papers) and structural isolation, creating urgency without being alarmist.

key_claims_mece_analysis.C1_scope: The opportunity exists and is academically legitimateestablishes that Ethereum research IS cryptography research worthy of top venues
key_claims_mece_analysis.C2_scope: The need existsJapan's structural challenges create both urgency and opportunity for external collaboration
key_claims_mece_analysis.C3_scope: The partner is credibleEthereum Foundation has the track record and resources to be a legitimate research collaborator
key_claims_mece_analysis.C4_scope: The mechanism is practicalNyx Foundation provides the bridge to reduce activation energy for engagement
key_claims_mece_analysis.mece_verification: Claims are mutually exclusive (no overlap in scope) and collectively exhaustive (together they answer: What opportunity? Why now? Who is the partner? How do we engage?)

decision_criteria_addressed.technical_merit: C1 directly addresses through evidence of publications at CRYPTO/EUROCRYPT/ASIACRYPT
decision_criteria_addressed.research_novelty: C1 addresses through specific RFP topics and unsolved problems
decision_criteria_addressed.practical_impact: Governing Thought includes 'trillion-yen-scale system used by millions'
decision_criteria_addressed.expertise_alignment: C1 explicitly mentions ZK proofs, post-quantum, formal verification matching Emura/Araki/Suga specializations
decision_criteria_addressed.funding_viability: C3 addresses with specific grant amounts ($2M round) and timelines (6-12 months)
decision_criteria_addressed.collaboration_quality: C3 and C4 address through EF track record and Nyx Foundation role
decision_criteria_addressed.career_development: C4 explicitly mentions graduate student opportunities

web_research_sources.findings: 2025 round launched with $2M fund; 2024 round funded 41 projects from 300 applications across 25 countries; covers cryptography, formal verification, security
Multiple Ethereum-relevant ZK papers published at EUROCRYPT (Aurora 2019, Groth16 2016) and CRYPTO (Lattice-based SNARKs 2022)
Japan dropped from 4th to 13th in Top 10% cited papers (1997-2023); output share fell from 7.4% to 4.7% (2005-2015); research spending grew only 10% vs 80% in US/Germany
PSE evolved from Applied ZKP (2018) to Privacy Stewards (2025); focuses on ZK-SNARKs, FHE, MPC; runs Acceleration Program with RFPs for Semaphore, MACI, Proof of Email
